home.aboutTitle: Engineer by training, designer by habit, researcher at heart.
home.aboutText1: {name} is what most people call me. I started as a graphic designer in a campus open-source community, moved into web development, and went deep into knowledge graphs and machine learning during my master's at IPB University.
home.aboutText2: Today I build payment systems and backend services from Greater Jakarta — and I still care about how things look and feel.
